jobs.prompt: Edit the FIRST referenced sprite sheet. Keep EXACTLY the same character, outfit, hair colors, 12 sprites and strict 3x4 layout with FRONT/LEFT/BACK/RIGHT rows; ALL three in each row same facing. Remove EVERY glow, aura, background haze, semitransparent shadow, ambient halo and soft paint spill around EVERY figure. The entire area between figures must be exact alpha=0. All interior skin/hair/clothing pixels must be fully opaque alpha=255, including all dark/black areas. Only a 1-2 pixel anti-aliasing edge may be semitransparent. Do not fade hair, bodies, hands or feet. Crisp clean isolated game sprite cutouts, absolutely NO soft gradients of TRANSPARENCY. Color shading inside figures is allowed and fully opaque. No outline glow. Transparent background. Keep twelve complete full bodies with generous gutters. SECOND reference is this character's own original portrait and native map poses, authoritative for facial features. Retain the PALE exposed angular adult face, sharp narrow eyes, long nose, thin bluegray mouth and blue long hair; no blank robotic mask.
jobs.initial_prompt: Edit/create a single transparent RGBA sprite-sheet master for an established HD1 chibi fantasy tactical game. First reference is the EXACT OWN original portrait plus twelve native map poses; use that identity, facial structure, colors, equipment and silhouette. Second reference is approved chibi proportion/style only (Ares); never copy that face, hair, armor or weapon. Match hand-painted clean bold readable 2D game art, very large head with short compact body, approximately 55-60% total height head, adult facial features translated into chibi without changing age. Twelve isolated full-body sprites arranged in a strictly regular 3 columns x 4 rows grid on a transparent 1536x1024 canvas, same scale and baseline per row, generous equal transparent cell gutters. Every full sprite including hair fits comfortably inside its cell. ROW1 ALL THREE face straight forward toward viewer, ROW2 ALL THREE face SCREEN LEFT (nose LEFT), ROW3 ALL THREE face straight BACK away from viewer, ROW4 ALL THREE face SCREEN RIGHT (nose RIGHT). In each row columns are subtle idle/left-foot-step/right-foot-step, never change facing for a step. Keep full body, both feet and empty hands unless native map shows an object. No scenery, ground planes, drop shadows, labels, panels, borders, opaque background or extra sprites. Preserve source asymmetry by rotating the same character, never arbitrarily mirror unilateral details. Do not invent lore or names. GROUP123: own angular PALE almost white face, sharp narrow dark eyes under strongly angled brows, a slim long pointed nose with a cool gray shadow, thin blue-gray lips with severe slightly raised corner, long blue hair in broad swept wavy locks; forehead side fringe and swept strands visible in source. Face is exposed pale skin, not an empty robot visor or black face. Do not paint giant child eyes or a featureless face. Native map outfit is pale gray-white compact torso armor/tunic with medium cool-gray horizontal high collar, pale shoulder caps and cuffs, deep navy sleeves/lower garment, dark gloves and boots, long blue hair reaching behind upper body. No swords/staff/cape invented. Strict profile-left for all row2, profile-right all row4. Front must show own adult sharp eyes/nose/thin mouth, back no face.
